editorial:
Imagine being twelve years old and deciding that sleepaway camp is so great you never want to leave. That is exactly what happens here. You get a group of wild kids who are tired of school and parents, so they hatch a crazy plan to live at camp forever. The vibe is totally chaotic and fun, feeling like a childhood dream gone wrong. You will love the chemistry between the kids as they try to hide from the adults, but the real star is Bob. He is a creepy, obsessed counselor who has lived at the camp for decades and will stop at nothing to keep the kids in line. It is like a game of cat and mouse, but with more mud and prank wars.

The acting is spot on, especially the guy playing Bob, who manages to be scary and hilarious at the same time. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though a few of the jokes feel a bit repetitive. If you want a lighthearted movie for family night, you should definitely check this out. It looks amazing if you can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the kids lure Bob into a giant pit of sticky marshmallow fluff during the camp bonfire. While he is stuck, they find out Bob was actually trying to protect a secret treasure buried under the mess hall. Instead of running away, the kids make a deal with the camp owner to stay for the summer in exchange for the gold. They don't live there forever, but they get a huge win over Bob.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy kids movies and slapstick humor.
